commits.message:
feat(aigc): harden distributed execution semantics

- IdempotencyStore: atomically claim (user, actionId) execution; in-memory for
  tests, Redis SET NX EX for production (tj.ai.harness.idempotency.store=redis);
  duplicate order.preview never double-executes, failures release for retry, and
  an unavailable store fails closed instead of silently duplicating
- Human handoff contract: HandoffRequest (HF- ticket, REQUESTED/ACKNOWLEDGED/
  RESOLVED lifecycle, redacted summary, 7-day TTL) generated on HUMAN_HANDOFF
  routes and riding the ROUTE event; frontend renders 已转人工 + handoffId

  malformed response, slow response); docs/failure-matrix.md maps every failure
  class to behavior, metric and test

  overflow drops intermediate chunks with a warning; race tests prove STOP is
  emitted exactly once and no data follows the terminal event; envelope gains
  version=1 (clients tolerate unknown fields)
- API contract: blank question rejected with 400-class exception before the
  model pipeline (ChatControllerContractTest)

commits.author: zhuoran
commits.message:
fix(aigc): harden routing, tool calling, SSE terminal guarantees and harness race

Major Agent-engineering reliability fixes (no breaking API changes):

1. Routing — AgentServiceImpl
   - Catch RouteAgent runtime failures (model timeout / Nacos / JSON parse)
     and degrade to HUMAN_HANDOFF with HIGH risk, so a flaky routing layer
     no longer breaks the entire SSE stream.
   - Plain-text fallback in parseRouteResult no longer leaks the raw
     user-facing text into candidateAgents; it now correctly falls back
     to HUMAN_HANDOFF when the LLM violates the JSON contract.

2. Tool calling — OrderTools
   - Guard against null ToolContext and null/empty courseIds, so the
     Spring AI dispatcher can no longer trigger an NPE or fire a Feign
     call with a missing requestId/userId.

3. SSE terminal guarantee — AbstractAgent
   - Replace takeWhile+concatWith with a Sinks.Many-based stream so
     PARAM/TRACE/STOP events are emitted on every terminal path
     (complete / cancel / error). Previously, when the user hit /chat/stop,
     takeWhile cancelled the upstream and the concatWith branch never
     ran, so the front-end never received a STOP event.
   - Persist the assistant reply to chat memory on the normal completion
     path too. Previously only doOnCancel saved history, which meant the
     normal end-to-end run never wrote the assistant turn.
   - Drop the dead ToolResultHolder.put(messageId, requestId) line that
     was carried over from the legacy ChatServiceImpl and did nothing
     in the current request-id-keyed flow.

4. Harness — HarnessEventRecorder
   - Per-request ReentrantLock around the read-modify-write of the trace
     list. Parallel tool calls in the same model response were losing
     traces due to a race; this is exercised by a new concurrency test.

5. Harness — AgentHarnessService
   - Log runtime exceptions (Feign / network / NPE) instead of silently
     returning a failed observation, so production issues are visible.

Tests:
- New HarnessEventRecorderConcurrencyTest: 32 parallel trace writers, asserts
  every trace is preserved.
- New shouldFallbackToHumanHandoffWhenRouteAgentThrows
- New shouldNotExposeRawPlainTextAsCandidateWhenRouteIsNotStructured
- New shouldCaptureRuntimeExceptionAsFailedObservation
- New shouldNotThrowWhenToolContextIsNull, shouldNotInvokeFeignWhenCourseIdsIsEmpty
- 39 tests passing (was 33).

commits.author: however-yir
commits.message:
fix: resolve security and reliability issues from bug review (2H/9M/12L)

High severity:
- Mermaid XSS: render with securityLevel "strict" and sanitize the
  rendered SVG with DOMPurify (added as a direct dependency) before
  injecting it into the DOM (web/chat-ui RichMarkdown.tsx).
- Arbitrary file write via attachment OCR: generate the temp file name
  server-side (fixed name + extension from a whitelist) instead of
  resolving the client-controlled originalFilename (InMemoryAttachmentService).

Medium severity:
- ThreadLocal pollution: OrderTools.prePlaceOrder and
  AgentRuntime.previewOrder now clear UserContext in try/finally so
  reused streaming threads cannot leak one user's identity into the
  next request (test updated to assert cleanup).
- KnowledgeOpsClient: wire connect/read timeouts from properties into
  the RestTemplate and URL-encode query params (user question included).
- Multipart limits: set spring.servlet.multipart max-file-size 8MB /
  max-request-size 20MB so the 8MB attachment check is reachable.
- Actuator: drop unauthorized /actuator/env from exposure.
- Embedding write endpoint: guarded by
  tj.aigc.embedding-write.enabled (default false) to prevent any
  logged-in user from poisoning the shared vector store.
- Empty question: reject blank /chat questions with 400 and make
  attachment validation errors visible as 400 (BadRequestException)
  instead of falling into the generic 500 handler; dev-demo
  buildParams is now null-safe.
- Routing: fall back to HUMAN_HANDOFF when nextAgent is missing or
  unknown so users always get an answer; AttachmentContextHolder now
  expires stale entries (1h TTL) to stop unbounded growth.
- Direct-access auth boundary documented: non-dev-demo profiles trust
  the gateway-injected user-info header and must sit behind tj-gateway
  or a private network (README security note).
- ChatClient beans: resolve builders lazily via ObjectProvider with
  cross-provider fallback so a disabled openai provider no longer
  breaks context startup in the local profile.
- JWT access-token TTL restored to 30 minutes (refresh flow via
  HttpOnly cookie already exists in tj-auth) instead of 30 days.

Low severity:
- ModelOptionsHolder is now cleared on the same request thread that
  set it (doFinally cleared the wrong thread).
- RedisChatMemory sets a rolling 30-day TTL on conversation keys.
- Rate limiter evicts stale IP counters once the map grows large.
- TTS emitter completion is guarded against double-complete races.
- Frontend shows a warning banner and keeps the draft/attachments when
  attachment upload fails.
- Removed duplicate empty `prompt:` key in application.yml.
- System prompts fall back to a built-in default when Nacos config is
  missing instead of null.
- SignUtils: NoSuchAlgorithmException now propagates instead of
  returning an empty token; verification parses AK containing dashes.
- Weather demo tools validate numeric city ids and use HTTP timeouts.
- Disabled ChatServiceImpl marked as not-in-use legacy code.
- README/demo docs aligned with the actual voice-input implementation
  (browser Web Speech API; /audio endpoints unused by the UI).
- Session example counts are clamped (and null-safe) in
  ChatSessionServiceImpl.

Verified: tjxt -pl tj-aigc -am install, tj-aigc unit tests (33),
my-spring-ai / openai-java-demo packages, chat-ui lint + vitest + build,
pytest smoke tests and enterprise launch validation all pass locally.
